name: Shimagami Tato
source:
"Damn~ I'm going to ruin all my crops while I'm doing this."

A super-skilled farmer who grew up in an ordinary family and developed more than 100 varieties. The crops he cultivates are so popular that they are distributed all over the country.

He likes to eat after work the most. He made the fact that he had to work hard to get something because he was engaged in agriculture as his life motto.

Maybe it's because he doesn't have a chance to go out to the city, but his fashion sense is bad. He has hidden small muscles trained in agriculture. What he hates most is vermin.

[Machine translated from [url=https://dangan.tistory.com/10]official source[/url] and edited where necessary]
